what_happened: Plan-time Lean runs settled the plan's central design question instead of leaving it to implementation: lean_run_code compiled (a) the free-register anchor clause from the six facts the landed common-shift proof already assembles plus exactly two bounds on the target register, (b) the non-removability of the lower bound with an explicit arithmetic witness, and (c) both pinned kappa-collision witness pairs by decide. That measurement is what split branch 3 into a dispatchable monotone half and an explicitly excluded antitone half, rather than defaulting to a blanket exclusion.

Phase 2's contingent retirement of exists_ladderPath_through_common_shifted_of_pend_past to the n0 := nxtAt g z + m*(P+1) instance REDUCES EXACTLY (probe compiled, zero diagnostics) but cannot be applied in place: Phase 1 pins section FreeRegister immediately AFTER end CommonShift, so the landed theorem would need a forward reference. Plan's fallback (leave landed proof untouched, close COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS) taken, with the real reason recorded rather than the anticipated one.

Phase 1's free-register raise and its necessity record both compiled on the FIRST attempt at the pinned Challenge signatures; the plan-time omega measurement of the anchor clause's exact six-fact set transferred to the Lean-level assembly with no adjustment. Full-library build is only ~22s warm, so every phase end can afford the full gate.

Phase 4's declared section placement (section FreeRegister) is unsatisfiable: cellAt_subset_of_free_register_shift_of_pend_past_rev consumes ForwardSlackWitnessed, which is defined inside section ForwardSlack (after end FreeRegister). Both Phase 4 declarations were placed in section ForwardSlack beside their landed counterparts instead. Same root cause as the Phase 2 exclusion: the plan pinned section FreeRegister after end CommonShift and then assigned to it declarations that consume later definitions. Signatures, names, order and proof routes unchanged.

All eleven declarations compiled at their pinned Challenge signatures with no statement adjustment; the two proof-heavy phases (1 and 4) and the four arithmetic records all closed on the first attempt. Prototyping Phases 5 and 6 out of tree with lean_run_code against the already-built module avoided two build-fail cycles. Every phase end was gated on a FULL-library build rather than the plan's scoped one, at ~22s warm — the stronger gate cost essentially nothing.
